source.title: FAA Type Certificate Data Sheet 4A21, Revision 8

envelope.name: Case I longitudinal CG envelope
envelope.calculation_points_note: Conservative convex inner subset of the source table. The source's small forward-limit notch at 185–190k lb is excluded because this demo assumes a convex envelope.

illustrative_inputs.notice: These values are deliberately illustrative and are not tail-specific approved loading data.

roaming_passengers.endpoint_model: Each passenger independently occupies one of the four weight/station endpoint combinations.

fuel_interpolation.note: Fuel waypoints are accumulated in fuel_sequence_order and linearly interpolated in weight-moment coordinates. The order is illustrative, not an approved fuel-use schedule.
